policy.scope: Conservative per-note original requirement mapping, not deletion authorization or a new overall audit.
policy.existingEvidence: October29 confirmations remain scoped/date/revision-bound; all finalEvidence arrays intentionally await parent actual checks.
policy.forthcomingChecks: Worker/parent pending status never means a test passed or a requirement closed.
policy.narrowSupplements: A narrow supplement may retire when its own original scope/assigned child slice passes even if a broader contextual canonical parent remains open. Do not generalize its pass to that parent.
policy.aggregateNotes: Aggregate/checkpoint/deployment/manual notes stay blocked while any original child or applicable external evidence is absent.
policy.deletions: Only parent may version top-level construction-branch note deletions after final proof. Original primary checkout remains e9052f9 and no original root note is eligible for deletion there.
policy.immutableEvidence: Preserve original historical JSON/SHA manifests and archived source copies unchanged. Active Markdown links may target the immutableOriginal githubBlob value. Do not rewrite archived data.
policy.noFreshNativeOrHardwareInference: Dated real native/hardware evidence is preserved; present skip/software rendering is not new native/hardware success.
policy.localArchivalAuthorization: Explicit user authorization covers exact local preservation of all577 selected files including PNG/PYC; no hypothetical per-file local clearance gate remains. SCN035 distribution/licensing requirements are unchanged.
